system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
I received a suspicious email from the address __email__. Is it safe to open it.

PREDICTED INTENT: account_compromised

PRECEDENTS:

[1915698] (similarity 0.62, intent account_compromised)
  past customer: I think my account got hacked! I got an email that it changed to a diff rando email? Should I respond to __email__?
  spotify replied: Hi! Sorry to hear that. You can reply to that email or contact our Accounts team through the contact form at <link>

[2198222] (similarity 0.57, intent account_compromised)
  past customer: I've had my premium account hacked and have been contacted by someone with the email address: __email__' asking for a copy of my earliest Spotify email receipt or a bank statement. Is this legit?
  spotify replied: Hey Mike! We can confirm that email came from us. They'll be the best folks to help out 🙂

[1853893] (similarity 0.56, intent account_compromised)
  past customer: has been hacked please help! - __email__
  spotify replied: 3: your previous tweet which contains your email address to protect your private account info. Give us a shout if anything else comes up

[2492563] (similarity 0.53, intent account_compromised)
  past customer: My account has been hacked! Please contact me ASAP. My email is __email__ - someone at email __email__ has hacked it.
  spotify replied: Hi Dan! Thanks for the info. It looks like our Accounts team's already on your case. Be sure to check your inbox (including your junk/spam folders) so you don't miss out. We hope everything gets fixed soon

[944973] (similarity 0.52, intent account_compromised)
  past customer: someone changed the email on my account. I mailed on the account, could you look at it?
  spotify replied: Hi there. We're sorry to hear that. We suggest filling up the contact form found in the 2nd step at <link>

Draft the reply as JSON.
